podcast.body: This album received quite good reviews, notable for featuring significantly less material from Noel Gallagher and a considerable amount from Liam Gallagher, alongside contributions from non-Gallagher members, a previously "unthinkable" situation. The recording process was particularly complicated due to internal band issues, including Liam Gallagher's abrupt departure during sessions to get married without informing anyone. "la propia grabación del diger un sol fue demasiado complicada, tenemos ya a esa neidot en la cual liamgala guerrilla en plena grabación, se larga y desaparece para volver a casarse sin decirle nada nadie."

srcs.episode: OASIS: Repasamos la historia de su separación.

podcast.body: This album was released on October 6, 2008, and performed well, reaching number one in the UK and number five in the US. An 18-month tour was planned following its release, but portions of it were cancelled due to an incident where Noel Gallagher was attacked on stage. "A new album called Dig Out Your Soul was released on October 6th, 2008. Again, all appeared reasonably well. The album went to number one in the UK, and all the way to number five in the US."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
